reason: I already have a fabric shop I trust and they know what I need, so I have no reason to gamble on a new one. 14.90 for black viscose is fine, but it isn't cheap enough to make me switch.
objection: The colour and drape on screen never match the real fabric, and I don't know this shop's quality, so I'd risk wasting money on a cut I can't return.
would_change_my_mind: Cheap swatches or a sample pack sent to my InPost locker, so I can see and feel the real colour before ordering metres.
